description: Removes a preferred, blocked or backup staff relationship from a client, as the chip's Remove does. relationship_id comes from the staff relationships read (read the client's relationships). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: remove_client_staff_relationship
title: Remove a cleaner's relationship from a client
